shortDescription: British insurer and money manager M&G LSE:MNG beat half-year profit expectations and forecast low double-digit annual profit growth on Thursday as strong client inflows from its Japanese partner Daiichi Life TSE:8750 cushioned the impact of market volatility due to the Iran war.
